---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new mode, option, or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who is affected and how?

## Proposed solution

Describe the desired behavior, including CLI options, flags, or
configuration. A mock-up of the command line is very helpful.

```bash
# Example of the proposed interface
iterecho --base-dir ./src --extensions .md watch
```

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why is this one better?

## Compatibility

- Does this change any default behavior?
- Does it require new dependencies?
- Does it work on all supported platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows)?

## Security implications

- Does this touch the file I/O, path validation, or extension blocklist?
- Does it change the lock or concurrency behavior?

## Additional context

Links, references, screenshots, prior art in other tools, etc.
